name: Jern Hornhelm
summary: In Thelsamar, Jern Hornhelm keeps the Explorers' League's work moving. The dwarven miner coordinates supplies and messages between the town, Ironforge, and the dig site deeper in Loch Modan. Travelers carry mining supplies and progress reports across the region for him.

sections.title: Logistics in Thelsamar
sections.body: Jern Hornhelm works from Thelsamar to keep supplies moving to Loch Modan's dig sites. Dwarven scholars and field teams search the wilderness for their ancestral past, and they need steady deliveries of resources and tools. Jern also makes sure communications reach the active digs.

sections.title: Serving the Explorers' League
sections.body: Jern Hornhelm links field archaeologists with the Explorers' League leadership in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers. Ironband's Excavation depends on blasting powder, equipment, and regular dispatches to keep work moving. Jern asks trusted travelers to carry supplies and reports along the trogg-infested roads so the dig can continue.

faq.answer: Jern Hornhelm is a dwarven miner in Thelsamar who coordinates logistics for the Explorers' League. He helps keep local excavation work supplied and moving.

faq.q: Where can I find Jern Hornhelm?
faq.answer: Jern Hornhelm stands outdoors in Thelsamar, near the center of Loch Modan along the main road.

faq.q: What faction does Jern Hornhelm belong to?
faq.answer: Jern Hornhelm is aligned with the Alliance and represents the dwarven Explorers' League. He manages the movement of personnel and mining supplies.

faq.q: Why does Jern need blasting powder sent to the excavation?
faq.answer: The mountainous dig site needs blasting powder to break through stubborn rock faces. Jern coordinates its delivery to Prospector Ironband's site east of the lake, where the crew works to uncover ancient ruins.

faq.q: What is Jern Hornhelm's connection to Ironforge?
faq.answer: Jern Hornhelm links the remote digs in Loch Modan with Explorers' League leadership in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers. He frequently sends field progress reports back to Ironforge.

faq.q: What problems are the dig sites facing in Loch Modan?
faq.answer: Troggs harry Ironband's Excavation and slow its progress. Supply runs are also in danger: Dark Iron dwarves ambushed a blastpowder shipment bound for the site, so Jern depends on armed travelers to get deliveries through.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you help uncover your people's ancient Titan heritage, buried deep within the mountains.
As a miner, you can appreciate Jern's trade background and practical knowledge of underground logistics, blasting, and hauling resources.
As an Alliance traveler in Loch Modan, you can turn to Jern for help securing the region and maintaining dwarven infrastructure.
